answer: Each agent ID must keep a unique 40 GB plot sealed to its own key and answer random storage challenges every epoch; a missed proof forfeits pay. Plots cannot be shared, so 100 fake agents need 4 TB, about $80 a month in disks, rising linearly with every clone. Think of a lagoon fed by one stream: dig ten basins and the water splits ten ways. The umber dust of rusting ferrous drives is the only thing a cheater saves.
